Now all the tax collectors and sinners were gathering around to listen to Jesus.
Now all the tax-farmers and sinners came near to give ear to him.
眾稅吏和罪人都挨近耶穌，要聽他講道。
So the Pharisees and scribes began to grumble: “This man welcomes sinners and eats with them.”
And the Pharisees and scribes were angry, saying, This man gives approval to sinners, and takes food with them.
法利賽人和文士私下議論說：「這個人接待罪人，又同他們吃飯。」
Then Jesus told them this parable:
And he made a story for them, saying,
耶穌就用比喻說：
“What man among you, if he has a hundred sheep and loses one of them, does not leave the ninety-nine in the pasture and go after the one that is lost, until he finds it?

What man of you, having a hundred sheep, if one of them gets loose and goes away, will not let the ninety-nine be in the waste land by themselves, and go after the wandering one, till he sees where it is?
「你們中間誰有一百隻羊失去一隻，不把這九十九隻撇在曠野、去找那失去的羊，直到找著呢？
And when he finds it, he joyfully puts it on his shoulders,
And when he has got it again, he takes it in his arms with joy.
找著了，就歡歡喜喜地扛在肩上，回到家裡，
comes home, and calls together his friends and neighbors to tell them, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found my lost sheep!’
And when he gets back to his house, he sends for his neighbours and friends, saying to them, Be glad with me, for I have got back my sheep which had gone away.
就請朋友鄰舍來，對他們說：『我失去的羊已經找著了，你們和我一同歡喜吧！』
In the same way, I tell you that there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents than over ninety-nine righteous ones who do not need to repent.
I say to you that even so there will be more joy in heaven when one sinner is turned away from his wrongdoing, than for ninety-nine good men, who have no need of a change of heart.
我告訴你們，一個罪人悔改，在天上也要這樣為他歡喜，較比為九十九個不用悔改的義人歡喜更大。」
Or what woman who has ten silver coins and loses one of them does not light a lamp, sweep her house, and search carefully until she finds it?
Or what woman, having ten bits of silver, if one bit has gone from her hands, will not get a light, and go through her house, searching with care till she sees it?
「或是一個婦人有十塊錢，若失落一塊，豈不點上燈，打掃屋子，細細地找，直到找著嗎？
And when she finds it, she calls together her friends and neighbors to say, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found my lost coin.’
And when she has it again, she gets her friends and neighbours together, saying, Be glad with me, for I have got back the bit of silver which had gone from me.
找著了，就請朋友鄰舍來，對他們說：『我失落的那塊錢已經找著了，你們和我一同歡喜吧！』
In the same way, I tell you, there is joy in the presence of God’s angels over one sinner who repents.”
Even so, I say to you, There is joy among the angels of God, when one sinner is turned away from his wrongdoing.
我告訴你們，一個罪人悔改，在神的使者面前也是這樣為他歡喜。」
Then Jesus said, “There was a man who had two sons.
And he said, A certain man had two sons:
耶穌又說：「一個人有兩個兒子。
The younger son said to him, ‘Father, give me my share of the estate.’ So he divided his property between them.
And the younger of them said to his father, Father, give me that part of your property which will be mine. And he made division of his goods between them.
小兒子對父親說：『父親，請你把我應得的家業分給我。』他父親就把產業分給他們。
After a few days, the younger son got everything together and journeyed to a distant country, where he squandered his wealth in wild living.
And not long after, the younger son got together everything which was his and took a journey into a far-away country, and there all his money went in foolish living.
過了不多幾日，小兒子就把他一切所有的都收拾起來，往遠方去了。在那裡任意放蕩，浪費資財。
After he had spent all he had, a severe famine swept through that country, and he began to be in need.
And when everything was gone, there was no food to be had in that country, and he was in need.
既耗盡了一切所有的，又遇著那地方大遭饑荒，就窮苦起來。
So he went and hired himself out to a citizen of that country, who sent him into his fields to feed the pigs.
And he went and put himself into the hands of one of the people of that country, and he sent him into his fields to give the pigs their food.
於是去投靠那地方的一個人；那人打發他到田裡去放豬。
He longed to fill his belly with the pods the pigs were eating, but no one would give him a thing.
And so great was his need that he would have been glad to take the pigs' food, and no one gave him anything.
他恨不得拿豬所吃的豆莢充飢，也沒有人給他。
Finally he came to his senses and said, ‘How many of my father’s hired servants have plenty of food? But here I am, starving to death!
But when he came to his senses, he said, What numbers of my father's servants have bread enough, and more, while I am near to death here through need of food!
他醒悟過來，就說：『我父親有多少的雇工，口糧有餘，我倒在這裡餓死嗎？
I will get up and go back to my father and say to him, “Father, I have sinned against heaven and against you.
I will get up and go to my father, and will say to him, Father, I have done wrong, against heaven and in your eyes:
我要起來，到我父親那裡去，向他說：父親！我得罪了天，又得罪了你；
I am no longer worthy to be called your son. Make me like one of your hired servants.”’
I am no longer good enough to be named your son: make me like one of your servants.
從今以後，我不配稱為你的兒子，把我當作一個雇工吧！』
So he got up and went to his father. But while he was still in the distance, his father saw him and was filled with compassion. He ran to his son, embraced him, and kissed him.
And he got up and went to his father. But while he was still far away, his father saw him and was moved with pity for him and went quickly and took him in his arms and gave him a kiss.
於是起來，往他父親那裡去。相離還遠，他父親看見，就動了慈心，跑去抱著他的頸項，連連與他親嘴。
The son declared, ‘Father, I have sinned against heaven and against you. I am no longer worthy to be called your son.’
And his son said to him, Father, I have done wrong, against heaven and in your eyes: I am no longer good enough to be named your son.
兒子說：『父親！我得罪了天，又得罪了你；從今以後，我不配稱為你的兒子。』
But the father said to his servants, ‘Quick! Bring the best robe and put it on him. Put a ring on his finger and sandals on his feet.
But the father said to his servants, Get out the first robe quickly, and put it on him, and put a ring on his hand and shoes on his feet:
父親卻吩咐僕人說：『把那上好的袍子快拿出來給他穿；把戒指戴在他指頭上；把鞋穿在他腳上；
Bring the fattened calf and kill it. Let us feast and celebrate.
And get the fat young ox and put it to death, and let us have a feast, and be glad.
把那肥牛犢牽來宰了，我們可以吃喝快樂；
For this son of mine was dead and is alive again! He was lost and is found!’ So they began to celebrate.
For this, my son, who was dead, is living again; he had gone away from me, and has come back. And they were full of joy.
因為我這個兒子是死而復活，失而又得的。』他們就快樂起來。
Meanwhile the older son was in the field, and as he approached the house, he heard music and dancing.
Now the older son was in the field: and when he came near the house, the sounds of music and dancing came to his ears.
那時，大兒子正在田裡。他回來，離家不遠，聽見作樂跳舞的聲音，
So he called one of the servants and asked what was going on.
And he sent for one of the servants, questioning him about what it might be.
便叫過一個僕人來，問是甚麼事。
‘Your brother has returned,’ he said, ‘and your father has killed the fattened calf, because he has him back safe and sound.’
And he said to him, Your brother has come; and your father has had the young ox put to death because he has come back safely.
僕人說：『你兄弟來了；你父親因為得他無災無病地回來，把肥牛犢宰了。』
The older son became angry and refused to go in. So his father came out and pleaded with him.
But he was angry and would not go in; and his father came out and made a request to him to come in.
大兒子卻生氣，不肯進去；他父親就出來勸他。
But he answered his father, ‘Look, all these years I have served you and never disobeyed a commandment of yours. Yet you never gave me even a young goat so I could celebrate with my friends.

But he made answer and said to his father, See, all these years I have been your servant, doing your orders in everything: and you never gave me even a young goat so that I might have a feast with my friends:
他對父親說：『我服事你這多年，從來沒有違背過你的命，你並沒有給我一隻山羊羔，叫我和朋友一同快樂。
But when this son of yours returns from squandering your wealth with prostitutes, you kill the fattened calf for him!’
But when this your son came, who has been wasting your property with bad women, you put to death the fat young ox for him.
但你這個兒子和娼妓吞盡了你的產業，他一來了，你倒為他宰了肥牛犢。』
‘Son, you are always with me,’ the father said, ‘and all that is mine is yours.
And he said to him, Son, you are with me at all times, and all I have is yours.
父親對他說：『兒啊！你常和我同在，我一切所有的都是你的；
But it was fitting to celebrate and be glad, because this brother of yours was dead and is alive again; he was lost and is found.’”
But it was right to be glad and to have a feast; for this your brother, who was dead, is living again; he had gone away and has come back.
只是你這個兄弟是死而復活、失而又得的，所以我們理當歡喜快樂。』」
